blocks.text: Indicate the number of individual risks in each box below.

row_labels: Number of very high probability risks

notes: The title block prints Date, not Date Prepared, and appears on page 1 only. A text block directly before a table or box is a printed heading, not a box of its own. Overall Project Risk and Individual Project Risks are section headings printed in small capitals (pdftotext reads them as OVERALL PROJECT RISK and INDIVIDUAL PROJECT RISKS); the instruction sentence under Individual Project Risks is printed on the form. The page 1 grid is a 5 by 5 count matrix whose column labels (VL, L, M, H, VH) print in a row beneath the grid with a blank corner cell; no axis titles are printed. In a table, the first entry of columns is the row-label column and an empty string means the header cell is printed blank. Critical Risks prints five rows numbered 1. to 5. in both the Top Risks and Responses cells. The Probability of Meeting Objectives, Range of Outcomes, Key Drivers of Variances and both Reserve Status tables are header cells over a single tall blank row. Probability of Meeting Objectives prints a trailing colon, dropped here. Used to Date, Used This Period and Remaining Reserve print twice, once in each reserve table. The prose Table 2.30 names elements (Overall project risk, Individual project risks, Quantitative analysis, Reserve status, Risk audit results (if applicable)) that the blank form breaks into the more specific printed labels above; the blank form wins.
